command:
set -e
cd "$HOME/telegram-video-cutter-bot"
STAMP="$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)"
BACKUP="$HOME/telegram-video-cutter-bot/backups/library_fix_$STAMP"
mkdir -p "$BACKUP"
cp source_sync.py "$BACKUP/source_sync.py"
cp library_nav.py "$BACKUP/library_nav.py"
TMP="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
curl -fsSL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Naruto0yt99/telegram-video-cutter-bot/main/source_sync.py" -o "$TMP/source_sync.py"
curl -fsSL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Naruto0yt99/telegram-video-cutter-bot/main/library_nav.py" -o "$TMP/library_nav.py"
python -m py_compile "$TMP/source_sync.py" "$TMP/library_nav.py"
install -m 644 "$TMP/source_sync.py" source_sync.py
install -m 644 "$TMP/library_nav.py" library_nav.py
printf 'UPDATED_FILES_OK\nBACKUP=%s\nPARSER_VERSION=' "$BACKUP"
grep -m1 '^PARSER_VERSION' source_sync.py
pkill -f '^python .*/telegram-video-cutter-bot/bot.py$' || true
printf 'BOT_RESTART_REQUESTED\n'
